about: O15 feature inventory. Every feature listed here needs at least one passing tester-army test on the exact commit before Dash is installed, promoted, sent over a channel/OTA, or merged (laws/release). Add a feature together with its army test; never list a feature without one, never remove one to get a pass.

features.title: Local host hardware usage in the host info sheet, separate from roster updates
tests: host info sheet shows local CPU, RAM, disk and load from the authenticated bridge
chat host info sheet shows resources without replacing session identity

features.title: Hosts lists online and recently offline phones, retaining fleet phones and hiding stale ghosts
tests: Hosts lists phones without offering harnesses and hides stale unregistered phones

features.title: Send confirmation retains newer ink without restoring submitted marks
tests: annotate-tldraw: confirmed send removes only submitted ink, retaining newer ink

features.title: Offline warm tldraw annotation and history
tests: annotate-tldraw: warm open, visible stroke, local assets and history

features.title: Unchanged sent annotation JSON and markers
tests: annotate-tldraw: sent dash.annotation.v1 bytes and stroke markers match Skia

a failed older page is retried, so a network blip does not leave the rail partial
the rail is on the left edge and the message text starts clear of it
every Hermes prompt is on the rail, on the right edge clear of the text, and tap and drag jump to the prompt shown

annotation-voice-quiet: tldraw entry does not surface voice UI or shift header

features.title: Bridge health and drain let running agents finish while new chat and voice turns are refused
tests: bridge drain preserves the running reply, refuses new chat and voice, and exits cleanly

features.title: Recover from STT model failures, report host reasons, and isolate temp filenames
tests: STT real-host checks missing model returns 503 with model directory reason
STT fixture load failure returns 503 then retries to 200 without restart
STT real-host checks malicious voice id does not touch HOME or TMPDIR files

live-preview-chip: auto-reload waits for the idle gate
live-preview-chip: auto-reload waits for a closed keyboard
live-preview-chip: same served SHA never triggers a reload loop

features.title: Defer auto-reload during streaming, annotation, and drafts; flush a draft before manual reload

live-reload-guards: annotation holds an update until Exit
live-reload-guards: a nonempty unsent draft holds an update
live-reload-guards: manual Reload now flushes a sub-debounce draft before reload

features.title: Never reload a served SHA until its launch bundle responds HTTP 200
tests: live-preview-health: an HTTP 500 bundle cannot reload until the same SHA builds
live-preview-health: rollback to the old SHA preserves the attempted SHA retry guard
